challenge.method: Check whether the FAQ merely mentions a coincidental reading interest or treats it as the sole reason for the choice.
challenge.results: The FAQ connects the reading to the naming decision and also describes qualities van Rossum wanted in a name. This supports the attributed association without establishing a sole motive or an alias chronology.

limitations: The release FAQ supplies an attributed explanation of the name choice and no historical alias chronology.
